newSources.title: Ministry of Labour and Industrial Relations (Employment Division), Work Permit Information Sheet: Summary of Main Procedures and Checklist of Documents (February 2026), linked from https://empment-labour.govmu.org/Pages/Work%20Permit/ApplicationWP.aspx
newSources.said: The non-citizen should generally be aged between 20 and 60 years … Accordingly, applications for a work permit in respect of holders of a tourist visa or student visa will not be entertained. It is to be noted that if the holder of a Work Permit does not travel to Mauritius to take up employment within 6 months of the date of issue of the Work Permit, same will lapse. After completion of the maximum ten years of stay and work in Mauritius, the worker should leave the country … Applications for New, Renewal and Transfer Cases of Work Permit have to be submitted online via the National E-Licensing platform (NELS) upon registration at https://business.edbmauritius.org. … The requirement to obtain a Permission in Principle prior to submitting a Work Permit application is no longer applicable. In addition, the existing quota/ratio system has been abolished, and the maximum allowable period of stay for foreign workers across all sectors has been standardised at ten (10) years. Employers must, however, demonstrate their inability to recruit locally. … a processing fee of Rs 700 should be paid per application within 5 days of post verification of completeness of applications. Upon approval of application, a non-refundable annual fee of Rs. 500 should be paid together with the prescribed work permit fees. … Applications for renewal of work permits should be submitted 3 months prior to the expiry of the current one.

attempts.result: Read in full

value: Mauritius work permit (Non-Citizens (Employment Restriction) Act 1973, s. 3(1)): the employer applies online via NELS (business.edbmauritius.org), the residence permit application following automatically; no Permission in Principle and no quota/ratio any more, but the employer must show it couldn't recruit locally (National Employment Department, mauritiusjobs.govmu.org); worker generally aged 20–60, not on a tourist or student visa; processing fee MUR 700 per application, then a non-refundable annual fee of MUR 500 with the prescribed permit fee (Non-Citizens (Work Permit) (Fees) Regulations 2013); contract vetted where pay ≤ MUR 50,000 a month; maximum stay 10 years in all sectors; permit lapses if not taken up within 6 months; renew 3 months before expiry.
notes: Changed against the secondary: UFE's 'le permis de travail ne peut excéder 4 ans (5 en zone franche)' and the prior request to the ministry are superseded (Information Sheet, February 2026). UFE same today. The scale of 'prescribed work permit fees' is in the 2013 Fees Regulations, not read.
